## {@name@} {#sec-t-{@slug@}}

```{r}
#| include: false
t <- "{@tenure@}"
tr <- ten[tenure == t]
## the name before a full stop, so "Ltd." does not end a caption with ".."
name_end <- sub("[.]$", "", tr$name)
b <- rd$boundary[[t]]
st <- b$stats
has_map <- is.na(b$reason) && !is.null(b$geoms)

## vegetation types with forest in either version, today or in any simulated landscape
tn_all <- rd$type_nrv[tenure == t]
tc_all <- rd$type_cc[tenure == t]
panel_types <- c("All species", sort(setdiff(unique(c(tn_all$vegType, tc_all$vegType)), "All species")))
panel_lab <- function(v) factor(report05_veg_label(v), levels = report05_veg_label(panel_types))
tn <- tn_all[vegType %in% panel_types][, panel := panel_lab(vegType)]
tc <- tc_all[vegType %in% panel_types][, panel := panel_lab(vegType)]
p_type <- report04_boxplot(tn, tc, ac, "Share of the type's forest area (%)")
h_type <- 1.7 * ceiling(length(panel_types) / 2) + 0.8
report05_save_png(p_type, fig_dir, paste0(t, "_types"), 6.5, h_type)

p_patch <- report04_patch_hist(rd$patch_nrv[tenure == t], rd$patch_cc[tenure == t])
report05_save_png(p_patch, fig_dir, paste0(t, "_oldpatches"), 6.5, 4)

dt <- rd$delta_type[tenure == t]
dall <- dt[vegType == "All species"][match(ac, ageClass)]
## the types that lead at least 5% of the forest in either version's median landscape
major <- rd$pct_share[tenure == t & p50 >= 0.05, unique(vegType)]
dtypes <- dt[vegType %in% major & !is.na(d_p50)]
dp <- rd$delta_patch[tenure == t][order(min_patch_ha)]
## the same as a share of each version's area simulated as forest
dps <- rd$delta_patch_share[tenure == t][order(min_patch_ha)]
cw_t <- cwp[tenure == t]
## captions here, not in the chunk options: a colon in an option's text breaks its YAML
cap_bnd <- sprintf(
  "Reporting boundary of %s in version 2 (dashed) and version 3 (solid), with the area added and dropped.",
  name_end
)
cap_type <- sprintf(
  "Simulated range (boxes) and current condition (red circles) of the share of forest in each age class, by vegetation type, in %s: version 2 (blue) and version 3 (green).",
  name_end
)
cap_patch <- sprintf(
  "Simulated area of old forest in large patches in %s, in the landscapes of version 2 (top, blue) and version 3 (bottom, green), with each version's current condition (red line).",
  name_end
)
cap_patch_tbl <- sprintf(
  "Old forest in large patches in %s: the simulated median and the current condition of each version, in hectares and as a share of that version's area simulated as forest.",
  name_end
)
## all forest by sub-region, where both versions report the same sub-region (matched by name)
ds <- rd$delta_sub[tenure == t]
has_sub <- nrow(ds) > 0L
sub_reason <- rd$sub_reasons[tenure == t]$reason
cap_sub <- sprintf(
  "Current and simulated median share of all forest by age class in each sub-region of %s that both versions report, in percent, and the change in the median from version 2 to version 3, in percentage points.",
  name_end
)
cap_delta <- sprintf(
  "Current and simulated median share of each vegetation type's forest by age class in %s, in percent, and the change in the median from version 2 to version 3, in percentage points.",
  name_end
)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
src <- if (cw_t$zone != tr$name) {
  sprintf("Version 2 called this tenure \"%s\".", cw_t$zone)
}
if (tr$basis == "author_choice") {
  src <- c(src, "No 2021 report covers this tenure, and the version 2 runs that include it give different results; the authors chose the run with the most recent summaries, and Appendix B lists the others.")
} else if (tr$basis == "report_2021") {
  src <- c(src, "Its version 2 results come from the run its 2021 report used.")
}
others <- cw_t$n_in_layer - 1L
src <- c(
  src,
  if (others > 0L) {
    sprintf(
      "Its version 2 results come from a run that also reported on %d other %s.",
      others, if (others == 1L) "tenure" else "tenures"
    )
  }
)
bnd <- if (is.na(b$reason)) {
  sprintf(
    "Its version 2 reporting boundary covered %s ha and the version 3 one covers %s ha (%s%%); %s%% of the version 2 area is inside the version 3 boundary, %s ha was added and %s ha dropped (@fig-bnd-{@slug@}).",
    ha(st$area_v2_ha), ha(st$area_v3_ha), signed1(st$pct_change),
    format(round(st$pct_overlap_of_v2, 1), nsmall = 1), ha(st$area_added_ha), ha(st$area_dropped_ha)
  )
} else {
  sprintf("The change in its reporting boundary could not be measured (%s).", b$reason)
}
age <- dall[, sprintf(
  "%s forest makes up a median %s%% of all forest in the version 2 landscapes and %s%% in version 3; today it is %s%% in version 2's current condition and %s%% in version 3's.",
  ageClass, pct(p50_v2), pct(p50_v3), pct(cc_v2), pct(cc_v3)
)]
big <- if (nrow(dtypes)) {
  x <- dtypes[which.max(abs(d_p50))]
  sprintf(
    "Among the vegetation types that lead at least 5%% of the forest in either version's median landscape, the median that changes most is the share of %s forest that is %s: %s%% in version 2 and %s%% in version 3 (@fig-type-{@slug@}).",
    tolower(report05_veg_label(x$vegType)), tolower(x$ageClass), pct(x$p50_v2), pct(x$p50_v3)
  )
}
cat(c(src, bnd, "", age, big), sep = "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-patch-{@slug@}
#| tbl-cap: !expr cap_patch_tbl
pt <- pd[, .(
  `Patches of at least` = paste(ha(min_patch_ha), "ha"),
  `Median v2 (ha)` = ha(p50_v2),
  `Median v2 (%)` = pct(p50_v2_share),
  `Median v3 (ha)` = ha(p50_v3),
  `Median v3 (%)` = pct(p50_v3_share),
  `Current v2 (ha)` = ha(cc_v2),
  `Current v2 (%)` = pct(cc_v2_share),
  `Current v3 (ha)` = ha(cc_v3),
  `Current v3 (%)` = pct(cc_v3_share)
)]
kbl(pt, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, align = "lrrrrrrrr") |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"), font_size = 7)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-delta-{@slug@}
#| tbl-cap: !expr cap_delta
d <- copy(dt)
d[, type := report05_veg_label(vegType)]
d[, key := fifelse(vegType == "All species", "0", type)]
d[, ageClass := factor(ageClass, levels = ac)]
setorderv(d, c("key", "ageClass"))
d[, show := fifelse(seq_len(.N) == 1L, type, ""), by = key]
out <- d[, .(
  `Vegetation type` = show,
  `Age class` = as.character(ageClass),
  `Current v2` = fifelse(is.na(cc_v2), "--", pct(cc_v2)),
  `Current v3` = fifelse(is.na(cc_v3), "--", pct(cc_v3)),
  `Median v2` = pct(p50_v2),
  `Median v3` = pct(p50_v3),
  Change = signed1(100 * d_p50)
)]
kbl(out, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, align = "llrrrrr", linesep = c("", "", "", "\\addlinespace")) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position", font_size = 7)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
if (has_sub) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "@tbl-sub-{@slug@} compares all forest by ecological sub-region, for the %d sub-regions both versions report.\n",
    uniqueN(ds$subregion)
  ))
} else if (length(sub_reason) && !is.na(sub_reason)) {
  cat(sprintf("Results by ecological sub-region are not compared for this tenure: %s.\n", sub_reason))
} else {
  cat("Version 2 and version 3 report no common ecological sub-region for this tenure.\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sub-{@slug@}
#| eval: !expr has_sub
#| include: !expr has_sub
#| tbl-cap: !expr cap_sub
d <- copy(ds)
d[, ageClass := factor(ageClass, levels = ac)]
setorderv(d, c("subregion", "ageClass"))
d[, show := fifelse(seq_len(.N) == 1L, subregion, ""), by = subregion]
out <- d[, .(
  `Sub-region` = show,
  `Age class` = as.character(ageClass),
  `Current v2` = fifelse(is.na(cc_v2), "--", pct(cc_v2)),
  `Current v3` = fifelse(is.na(cc_v3), "--", pct(cc_v3)),
  `Median v2` = pct(p50_v2),
  `Median v3` = pct(p50_v3),
  Change = signed1(100 * d_p50)
)]
kbl(out, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, align = "llrrrrr", linesep = c("", "", "", "\\addlinespace")) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position", font_size = 7)
```
